notes: Italy's taxes relevant to the family (26% substitute tax on gains and dividends, flat-tax regime for new residents, IVAFE/IVIE, inheritance and gift tax) are national, so no region overrides them. Regional/municipal IRPEF surcharges (addizionali) are computed on the progressive IRPEF base only (art. 50 D.Lgs. 446/1997); IRAP is a business tax. Per-region surcharge rates were not tabulated here. Note for the national file: Normattiva shows the TUIR (DPR 917/1986) repealed by D.Lgs. 19 June 2026 n. 117 with effect from 1 January 2027 (recodification); tax year 2026 is unaffected.

units.name: Piemonte
units.summary: Piemonte: no regional difference for the family's taxes. Capital gains, dividends and interest of a private investor taxed at the 26% imposta sostitutiva (or withholding as final tax), IVAFE, IVIE and inheritance tax are national and identical in this region. The regional IRPEF surcharge (addizionale regionale, 1.23% base rate, raised by many regions) and the municipal surcharge apply only to income in the progressive IRPEF base (reddito complessivo, art. 50 D.Lgs. 446/1997), not to investment income under the 26% substitute tax; they matter only for salary, pension or other ordinary income.
